newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: BHP to close Newcastle steelmaking-analyst.
newsitem.headline: BHP to close Newcastle steelmaking-analyst.

text.p: The Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd was likely to close steel making facilities at Newcastle, but keep rolling facilities, leading BHP analyst Elaine Prior said on Monday.

"What BHP will do is close the steel making facilities at Newcastle, that's the blast furnaces and liquid steel stage, but I think they will maintain rolling facilities," Prior said on Australian Broadcasting Corporation (ABC) radio.
